faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Rogi Kalyan Samiti, NAMO Hospital, Daman, for various healthcare positions under contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available across different posts including Hospital Manager, Medical Officers, and ECG Technician.

faq.question: Q3. What are the available posts in NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Hospital Manager, Medical Officers, and ECG Technician (Female) under this healthcare recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 6 October 2026. Candidates must send their applications prior to this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email to [email protected] or sent to the designated office address by post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Hospital Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with an MBA in Hospital Administration / Healthcare Management along with 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to any of these posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Medical Officers?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Medical Officers position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 70,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their educational qualifications and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website for details?
faq.answer: You can check the official website of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu at www.ddd.gov.in for updates.
